title: Debug: the skipping remover
prompt: `removeAll(list, value)` should remove EVERY occurrence of value, but the forward loop skips the element right after each removal ("aab" removing 'a' leaves one 'a'). Fix it — the signature stays.

tests.name: no skips
tests.hint: iterate BACKWARDS (from size()-1 down to 0), or don't advance i after a removal.
